segments.name: Asset Management
segments.description: Investment management services across private equity, real assets, credit strategies, and capital markets for institutional and individual investors.
segments.evidence: In Asset Management, we have five business lines: (i) Private Equity, (ii) Real Assets, (iii) Credit and Liquid Strategies, (iv) Capital Markets, and (v) Principal Activities.

segments.name: Insurance
segments.description: Retirement and life insurance solutions provided through Global Atlantic, acquired in 2021.
segments.evidence: Our business further expanded with the acquisition of Global Atlantic in 2021, which today conducts our insurance business providing retirement and life insurance solutions.

segments.name: Strategic Holdings
segments.description: Strategic investments held for long-term value creation and dividend generation.
segments.evidence: In the first quarter of 2024, we implemented strategic initiatives that included creating our Strategic Holdings business segment.

revenueModel.text: Earn recurring management fees and performance revenues from institutional and individual investors for investment management services, transaction fees as broker-dealer, carried interest from investment gains on third-party capital, and investment income from own capital deployment.
revenueModel.evidence: As an asset management firm, we earn recurring management fees and fee-related performance revenues for providing investment management services and expertise to our institutional and individual investors who entrust us with their capital.
